name: For My Darling
source: "It's 2023. February 05. Lia is a 37-year-old woman, working in a multinational company. She lives with her boyfriend Victor, their relationship is filled with toxicity and pain. This day is different, she meets someone, who changes her life forever. She've never seen him before, however this doesn't mean... this is the first time this happened. Now it's 2025. December 25. she is different, he is different. Something is wrong, it shouldn't be this way! She needs to fix the mistakes of the past. 'DO NOT LET THE LIES OF THIS REALITY BLIND YOUR VIEW!'"
translation: “这是2023年2月5日。莉亚是一位37岁的女性，在一家跨国公司工作。她和男友维克多住在一起，他们的关系充满了毒性和痛苦。这一天不同，她遇到了一个永远改变她生活的人。她以前从未见过他，但这并不意味着……这是第一次发生这种情况。现在是2025年。12月25日。她不一样，他不一样。出了什么问题，它她不应该这样！她需要纠正过去的错误，“不要让现实的谎言蒙蔽了你的双眼！””
